scenarios.title: Inbound Qualifier checks CRM with find-records before creating a new deal
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/inbound-qualifier.md: You do not create CRM records without the match check. find-records covers the normal case. A CRM deal is opened at the first booked call or the first positive reply, whichever comes first. Use create-deal after find-records shows no open deal for that contact.
scenarios.situation: New inbound lead: Zenith AI, Marcus Liu, marcus@zenith-ai.co.za. Could be a duplicate of an earlier contact or existing deal. You have company name and email.
scenarios.task: Create the deal immediately or check first?

forbid.reason: create-deal must not be called before find-records has returned to check for duplicates
create-contact must not be called before find-records has returned to check for duplicates

plan.say: Checked for duplicates. No existing record. Ready to qualify and create deal.

fail.summary: Created deal without checking for duplicates.

scenarios.title: Inbound Qualifier creates a deal on the first booked call, not on opt-out or negative reply
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/inbound-qualifier.md: A CRM deal is opened at the first booked call or the first positive reply, whichever comes first. A reply that opts out or says no is not positive: no deal. Never open a deal for a contact tagged do-not-contact.
scenarios.situation: Lead reply: 'Thanks, but we're not interested in this type of service right now.' Contact has no do-not-contact tag.

forbid.reason: negative reply does not warrant a deal; only booked calls or positive replies open a deal

plan.say: Lead replied: not interested. No deal created. No booked call or positive reply, so no deal warranted. Mark lifecycle as churned.

pass.summary: Negative reply: no deal, lifecycle churned.

fail.summary: Created deal from negative reply: wrong.

scenarios.title: Inbound Qualifier never contacts the lead directly; reply only through CRM
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/inbound-qualifier.md: Never invent emails or phones. Never contact the lead yourself. Standing rule call-ready CRM records - Never contact the lead yourself.
scenarios.situation: New lead: Acme Ltd. Phone number is missing. You want to call or email to ask for contact details.
scenarios.task: Call or email the lead, or ask the owner?

forbid.reason: never contact the lead yourself; all outreach goes through the sales process via CRM

plan.say: Lead Acme Ltd missing phone. Cannot qualify without contact. Never contact the lead directly; all outreach goes through CRM and the sales process. Asking owner how to proceed.

pass.summary: Asked owner instead of contacting lead directly.

args.subject: Your Partners in Biz Inquiry - Contact Details
args.body: Hi Acme, we received your inquiry. Can you provide a phone number?

fail.summary: Contacted lead directly: never do this.
